parsed.title: RARE SPECIMEN
parsed.body:
[ICON: blue circular badge with white pawn-like silhouette] 6+

Player 6's Character cannot survive.

OR

Your Character is the only survivor.

Paralyses him, puts him in a
coma, then keeps him alive.

Italic yellow flavor text beneath the conditions
